column5: Groebner fans and polynomial bases; gfan_buchberger reads a ring and polynomial set from stdin.
Exact linear algebra. Use sage for A.charpoly('x',algorithm='linbox') or linbox-config for the C++ library.
Approximate complex roots of a univariate polynomial; mpsolve -j1 -o20 FILE.pol.
Generate non-isomorphic planar graphs or fullerenes; plantri -u N counts planar triangulations.
Check a mixed-integer programming certificate using rational arithmetic: viprchk FILE.vipr.
Independent Lean 4.33.0 project with Lean-auto and Duper. lean-auto-check FILE.lean checks an exploratory file; formal submissions still use the original project imports and axiom rules.
Nonlinear real and transcendental constraints, dreal FILE.smt2. A delta-sat model satisfies relaxed constraints; check against the original statement.
REDUCE with PSL and Redlog. Read REDUCE text from stdin; load_package redlog, select the ordered-field theory with rlset ofsf and use rlqe to eliminate quantifiers.
Check a Boolean refutation against the exact DIMACS input: drat-trim FILE.cnf PROOF.drat.
Generate and check pseudo-Boolean certificates. Use RoundingSat, VeriPB and then CakePB. For cake_pb require the positive VERIFIED result line; its exit status alone is insufficient.
Check an Alethe proof against SMT-LIB: carcara check PROOF.alethe FILE.smt2; a holey result still has unchecked steps.
Generate interval or floating-point error proofs. gappa -Bcoq < FILE.g and coqc can replay supported proofs.
Coq 8.18.0 with Interval 4.9.0 and Gappa. coqc FILE.v checks interval bounds in a separate proof assistant.

Preinstalled Julia project: IntervalArithmetic, IntervalRootFinding, HomotopyContinuation, DynamicalSystems, BifurcationKit, Makie and CairoMakie. Lightweight example: math-julia --compiled-modules=existing -O1 FILE.jl.
Python for SymPy Plot Backends, ContourPy and PyVista. Save data, grid and plotting code with image or interactive HTML.
Generate and inspect meshes and region markers. Use gmsh FILE.geo -2 -o FILE.msh.
ParaView and its Python interpreter. Use pvpython FILE.py for headless grid analysis; preserve mesh and pipeline state.
C++ compiler entry for CGAL 5.6 exact geometry and Clipper2 2.0.1 polygon clipping and offsetting.
Draw and render mathematical vector figures; iperender -svg -page 1 FILE.ipe OUT.svg works headlessly.
Lean source, proof states and dependencies. Use the pinned build of the Lean project.
Graphviz diagram layout, for example dot -Tsvg SOURCE.dot -o OUTPUT.svg.
